user.title: Add Solar of Things Station
user.description:
Choose how to authenticate with the Siseli portal.

**User ID + Password** is recommended — the integration logs in automatically and refreshes the token without any manual steps.

**IOT Token** is for advanced use or if you prefer not to store credentials.

More info: {docs_url}

password.title: Solar of Things — User ID + Password
password.description:
Enter your Siseli portal login credentials.

- **User ID**: your account/login name on https://solar.siseli.com (a name, not a number)
- **Station ID**: optional — leave blank and your stations are listed for you after login. If you type one, it is the numeric `stationId` from the portal, **not** the serial number or DTU-ID printed on your inverter or WiFi dongle.
- **Device ID**: optional — leave blank to auto-discover all devices under the station
- **Time zone**: must match your inverter's configured time zone

More info: {docs_url}

data.station_id: Station ID (optional — blank to pick from your account)
data.time_zone: Time zone (full IANA id, e.g. Europe/Warsaw — not just "Europe")

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Solar of Things
reauth_confirm.description: The access token has expired. Enter your updated password (or a fresh IOT Token) to continue.

station.title: Choose your station
station.description: These are the stations on your Siseli account. Pick the one to add.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Solar of Things API. Check credentials, Station ID, and network access.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid user ID or password. Please try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs for details.
error.invalid_time_zone: That's not a valid time zone id. Use a full IANA zone like "Europe/Warsaw" or "America/New_York" — not a continent or country name.
error.station_not_found: That Station ID wasn't found on your account (a DTU-ID or serial number is a common mix-up). Pick your station from the list.
error.no_stations: Logged in, but no stations were found on this account. Enter your Station ID manually.
